title: Speaker-labeled transcription with WhisperX on SageMaker AI
summary: The AWS WhisperX Deep Learning Container packages Whisper, wav2vec2 forced alignment, and speaker diarization into a GPU-ready image. Learn how to deploy it to Amazon SageMaker AI real-time and asynchronous endpoints for word-level, speaker-labeled transcription, plus the product
reason: AWS official blog announces the WhisperX Deep Learning Container for SageMaker AI, a developer resource/tool packaging open-source Whisper, wav2vec2 alignment, and speaker diarization for deployment, covered by the open-source tools/dev resources rule.
